name: continuous_clip_encoder
summary: Warm CLIP daemon that tails every JSONL sink (program_events, correlations, mocap, DOM, render output) and embeds every event into a shared 512-d vector space. The NN's vector axis in dim_pack now carries real semantic signal instead of SHA hash. Same event always produces the same vector (deterministic) so the training corpus is reproducible.

passes.notes: Loads CLIPModel + CLIPProcessor from HF cache. ~1.1 GB RSS on CPU; ~600 MB VRAM on GPU. Auto-fallback to CPU on CUDA OOM.

6 sinks tailed: program_events/**/*.jsonl, correlations/*.jsonl, meta_xr_mocap.jsonl, snap_lens_mocap.jsonl, phantom_dom_events.jsonl, chain_renders/_video_queue.completed.jsonl. Offsets at ~/.cc/embeddings/_encoder_offsets.json. Single-instance lockfile.

Per-source canonical sentence → CLIP text encoder. If event references an image_path that exists, falls through to CLIP image encoder so chain text events and rendered tiles sit in the same 512-d space.
Maintains a cosine-similarity index. numpy path active (matmul); stdlib fallback linear scan. Singleton at ~/.cc/embeddings/_index.bin + _index_meta.jsonl.

4-tier priority: (1) inline embedding_hex, (2) embedding_index lookup by crystal_id, (3) multi_layer_hex, (4) SHA-256 fallback. NN's vector axis carries real CLIP signal whenever the encoder has seen the event.
